newsitem.title: USA: Health Fitness acquires therapists network.
newsitem.headline: Health Fitness acquires therapists network.

text.p: Health Fitness Physical Therapy Inc said Tuesday its subsidiary, Health Fitness Rehab Inc, has acquired Preferred Companies, a national network of private-practice physical therapists.

Preferred Companies operates under the business name Preferred Therapy Providers of America. The network comprises more than 6,000 physical, occupational and speech therapists practicing at 1,100 clinic locations in 47 states. It contracts with payor sources representing more than 50 million lives.

"Preferred Therapy Providers gives us a greatly expanded channel for marketing our services to managed care and other payor services," said Thomas Coplin, president of Health Fitness Rehab, which operates a network of 36 outpatient and on-site physical therapy clinics.
Preferred Therapy Providers began operations in 1992. It is based in Scottsdale, Ariz.
Health Fitness provides preventive and rehabilitative services. It currently manages corporate and hospital-based fitness centers in 36 states.
Shares of Health Fitness were trading up 1/8 to 2-3/4.
